headline: Japan begins phased government AI-agent rollout under a new governance standard
summary: Japan’s Digital Agency announced a staged expansion of its Gennai government AI service to agent workflows, with Agent Chat rolling out to ministries for an eligible workforce of about 180,000 and a more advanced agent-building environment targeted for December 2026. The agency also published a governance, security and safety standard that assigns duties to users, administrators and developers, requires risk-based controls and human oversight, sets data-handling and logging rules, and addresses prompt injection and hallucinations. This is evidence of a public-sector deployment plan and its stated controls, not evidence of achieved adoption or measured outcomes.
